texts.orig: The Company's effective tax rates differ from the U.S. federal statutory rate of 21% for the years ended December 31, 2019 and December 31, 2018, primarily due to the benefit of tax credits and earnings in foreign jurisdictions which are subject to lower tax rates, offset by additional GILTI tax in the US and withholding taxes.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The Company's effective tax rate differs from the U.S. federal statutory rate of 35% for the year ended December 31, 2017, primarily due to the benefit related to the wind down of our solar inverter business and earnings in foreign jurisdictions, which are subject to lower tax rates, offset by the impact of U.S. tax reform.
